migration_flags.detail: sale.order.line has no analytic_account_id field in v19. Any v16/v17 migration that maps analytic_account_id must be rewritten to populate analytic_distribution (Json).
The nothing-to-invoice selection value is 'no', not 'no_need'. Any domain filter or Python comparison using 'no_need' will silently miss records.
There is no 'done' state in v19 Community. Any code that checks state=='done' or writes state='done' will fail. The equivalent is state='sale' with locked=True.
_prepare_confirmation_values() always sets date_order=now() on confirmation, overwriting the original quotation creation date.
_action_confirm() has no body in the base sale module. Downstream logic (stock moves, POs) lives in sale_stock and purchase_stock. Do not assume procurement documents are created from base sale.

key_findings.state_machine: Four states: draft→sent→sale→cancel. No done. Confirmation sets state=sale and date_order=now() atomically.
key_findings.invoice_status: Four values: no/to invoice/invoiced/upselling. Computed from aggregate of line statuses. Only sale-state orders can be non-no. Value is 'no' not 'no_need'.
key_findings.commitment_date: Manual datetime field (Delivery Date in UI). Non-computed. expected_date is computed as min(date_order+customer_lead) across consumable lines but NOT stored.
key_findings.analytic_distribution: Json field from analytic.mixin inheritance. analytic_account_id does NOT exist on sale.order.line in v19. Auto-populated from distribution model rules.
key_findings.qty_delivered_method: Base sale: manual or analytic only. stock_moves added by sale_stock. timesheet added by sale_timesheet.
key_findings.create_invoices: Grouping by company+partner+shipping+currency+fiscal_position. Created in sudo. Down-payments placed at invoice end. Negative-total moves switched to refund when final=True.
key_findings.multi_company: _check_company_auto=True + explicit constraint on order line products. Sequence namespaced per company.
